name: Succubus Tale: Aini's Hell
source: You step into the boots of an adventurer - a hero, perhaps. Your mission failed, your party wiped out by overwhelming forces in the shadowy depths of a forgotten dungeon. You are the sole survivor, running not just from the monsters, but from the ghosts of your failure. Exhausted, broken, and desperate, you stumble upon a light in the pitch-black, godforsaken forest: a quaint, welcoming tavern. You’ve found salvation in the middle of nowhere... or have you?
